_public_note: Public build manifest. Verbatim retail source strings are stored as SHA-256 digests (fields ending in _sha256); the builder recomputes them from the user's own ROM. Japanese text in this file is written by this project.
_note: JP retail glyph codes that an audit needs to print but no editorial manifest attests in kanji_codes. Each is named from the JP retail font bitmap itself (python ffta_jp_charset.py --show <code>) and the JP retail record it appears in -- never from charset_cn.json, whose slots the Chinese build re-assigned. Consumed by ffta_jp_charset.py.
